fact: Car 22 appeared to impede Car 16 in turn 13. Infringment Alleged breach of Article 37.5 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 22 (Yuki Tsunoda), the driver of Car 16 (Charles Leclerc), team representatives and reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, timing, telemetry, team radio and in-car video evidence. Car 22 was slowed by Car 2 in the area of Turn 10 and as a result aborted his push lap partway down the straight between Turns 12 and 13. Meanwhile Car 16 was on a push lap closing rapidly. The driver of Car 16 stated that he backed off "as a precaution" and conceded that this was a difficult situation for the team of Car 22 to manage, in the short distance prior to Turn 13. Accordingly we determine that Car 22 did not unnecessarily impede Car 16.
rules_referenced: Article 37.5 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Decision Alleged Impeding Of Car 16
